verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents serverless pay-per-token pricing and has a public pricing page (fireworks.ai/pricing) with self-serve billing controls and per-token pricing modifiers such as batch at 50% off and cached-input discounts. However, the pack never shows actual per-model token prices or confirms that every hosted model is listed. Missing for 10: an evidenced per-model price table covering all hosted models, and independent confirmation that prices are fully public without a sales contact.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Use popular models instantly with pay-per-token pricing.
